documents.name: Incorporation Package (Delaware)
documents.license_note: Free document generator under Cooley GO's terms of use; produces certificate of incorporation, bylaws, initial board consent, stockholder consent, and founder restricted stock purchase documents. Not legal advice — have counsel review before filing.

documents.name: Incorporation Package (Nevada)
documents.license_note: Free generator under Cooley GO's terms of use for the Nevada counterpart of the Delaware package. Nevada corporate law differs materially from Delaware's — counsel confirms the entity-state choice before filing.

documents.name: Public Benefit Corporation Incorporation Package (Delaware)
documents.license_note: Free generator under Cooley GO's terms of use for a Delaware public benefit corporation. The PBC's stated public benefit and directors' balancing duties are charter-level choices — counsel review before filing.

documents.name: Wholly Owned Subsidiary Incorporation Package
documents.license_note: Free generator under Cooley GO's terms of use for spinning up a wholly owned Delaware subsidiary — the usual structure when a non-US parent needs a US entity. Cross-border tax treatment needs specialist counsel.

documents.name: How to Form a New Business Entity (official instructions and certificate forms)
documents.license_note: Official state publication; the linked certificate forms are the state's own filing instruments.

documents.name: Form SS-4 — Application for Employer Identification Number
documents.license_note: US government work, public domain. Filing an SS-4 (or the free online EIN application) costs nothing; paid EIN services resell this form.

documents.name: Form 15620 — Section 83(b) Election
documents.license_note: US government work, public domain. The 30-day filing window is jurisdictional — see rule card us-fed.83b-filing-period; tax counsel should confirm the election is appropriate.

documents.name: Model articles of association for limited companies
documents.license_note: Crown copyright, published under the Open Government Licence. The statutory default articles for UK private companies limited by shares; venture-backed UK companies typically replace them with bespoke articles at the first priced round.

documents.name: Startup India legal and HR template library (founder agreement, employment, NDA, term sheets)
documents.license_note: Free government-published template repository (founder agreement, employment agreement, NDAs, CCD/equity term sheets and more) with an online document builder. Indian company-law formalities still need local counsel. NB: 'reources' in the path is the site's own spelling.

documents.name: Post-Money SAFE — Valuation Cap Only
documents.license_note: Released by YC for anyone to use; YC asks that only the blanks be filled, not the standard text edited. Created 2013; YC standardized on the post-money form in 2018 and the page states no per-form version dates. Direct asset links are content-hashed and rotate — always download from the page.
documents.jurisdiction: US (international variants on the same page)

documents.name: Post-Money SAFE — Discount Only
documents.license_note: Released by YC for anyone to use; fill the blanks, don't edit the standard text. Download from the page (asset links rotate).

documents.name: Post-Money SAFE — MFN Only (uncapped, no discount)
documents.license_note: Released by YC for anyone to use; fill the blanks, don't edit the standard text. Download from the page (asset links rotate).

documents.name: SAFE Pro Rata Side Letter
documents.license_note: Released by YC for anyone to use. Grants the SAFE holder a right to purchase in the next equity financing; model the dilution before signing (lib/openstartup/capTable.ts implements the User Guide arithmetic).
documents.jurisdiction: US (international variants on the same page)

documents.name: Post-Money SAFE international variants — Canada, Cayman Islands, Singapore (cap-only SAFEs + pro rata side letters)
documents.license_note: Released by YC for anyone to use; each jurisdiction gets a valuation-cap SAFE and a matching pro rata side letter on the same page. Local securities and corporate law still apply — local counsel required.

documents.name: Post-Money SAFE User Guide
documents.license_note: Free explanatory guide to the SAFE forms; its Appendix II worked cap tables are reproduced number-for-number in lib/openstartup/__tests__/capTable.test.ts.

documents.name: Series A Term Sheet Template
documents.license_note: YC's annotated standard term sheet, published for anyone to use as a clean baseline. A term sheet is not the definitive documents — counsel drafts those (typically from the NVCA suite).

documents.name: Y Combinator SAFE Financing Documents Generator (US)
documents.license_note: Free generator that fills YC's own post-money SAFE forms under Cooley GO's terms of use — a convenience wrapper, not a fork; the canonical forms live at ycombinator.com/documents.

documents.name: Y Combinator SAFE Financing Documents Generator (UK)
documents.license_note: Free generator adapting the YC SAFE for English-law companies under Cooley GO's terms of use. UK investors often want SEIS/EIS relief, which a SAFE can jeopardise — compare seedlegals-seedfast and take UK counsel.

documents.name: Y Combinator SAFE Financing Documents Generator (Singapore)
documents.license_note: Free generator producing the Singapore-law adaptation of the YC SAFE under Cooley GO's terms of use; YC's own Singapore variant also lives on ycombinator.com/documents.

documents.name: SAFE Financing Toolkit (US)
documents.license_note: Free toolkit in Orrick's Tech Studio forms library; downloads may require registration and are subject to Orrick's site terms. Useful second source alongside YC's canonical forms.

documents.name: KISS — Keep It Simple Security, debt and equity versions (500 Global)
documents.publisher: 500 Global (500 Startups); generator hosted by Cooley GO
documents.license_note: 500 Startups released KISS as open-source financing documents; Cooley GO's free generator is the live canonical home — 500.co/kiss now renders a bare logo shell with no documents. Debt version accrues interest and matures; equity version does not. Counsel for securities filings.

documents.name: Series Seed equity documents (open-source originals)
documents.license_note: The original open-sourced Series Seed preferred-stock documents, maintained on GitHub (repo states its own license terms); seriesseed.com remains unreachable. For a guided fill, cooley-series-seed-package generates the same set.

documents.name: Series Seed Equity Financing Package
documents.license_note: Free generator for the open-sourced Series Seed preferred-stock documents (originals at series-seed-github). Counsel review required before closing.

documents.name: Series Seed Convertible Note Financing Package
documents.license_note: Free generator for a complete seed convertible-note round (note purchase agreement + notes) under Cooley GO's terms of use. Notes carry maturity and interest mechanics SAFEs do not.

documents.name: NVCA Model Certificate of Incorporation (updated October 2025)
documents.license_note: Openly downloadable model charter maintained by the NVCA general counsel committee; free per the site's terms, offered as a starting point only. Heavily bracketed — counsel's document, not self-serve.

documents.name: NVCA Model Stock Purchase Agreement (updated October 2025)
documents.license_note: Openly downloadable model SPA for a Series A preferred financing; free per the site's terms, a starting point only. The disclosure schedule is the company-specific work counsel does.

documents.name: NVCA Model Investors' Rights Agreement (updated October 2025)
documents.license_note: Openly downloadable model IRA (registration rights, information rights, pro rata); free per the site's terms, a starting point only — counsel negotiates the brackets.

documents.name: NVCA Model Voting Agreement (updated June 2026)
documents.license_note: Openly downloadable model voting agreement (board composition, drag-along); free per the site's terms, a starting point only. The June 2026 refresh is the newest of the suite — use the current download.

documents.name: NVCA Model Right of First Refusal and Co-Sale Agreement (updated April 2026)
documents.license_note: Openly downloadable model ROFR/co-sale agreement; free per the site's terms, a starting point only — transfer restrictions interact with the bylaws and charter.

documents.name: NVCA Model Management Rights Letter (updated July 2020)
documents.license_note: Openly downloadable model letter giving VCA-plan investors ERISA 'management rights'; free per the site's terms. Routine, but it exists for the investor's regulatory reasons — counsel explains what it obliges.

documents.name: NVCA Model Indemnification Agreement (updated July 2020)
documents.license_note: Openly downloadable model director indemnification agreement; free per the site's terms. Interacts with the charter's exculpation clause and D&O insurance — counsel aligns all three.

documents.name: NVCA Model Legal Opinion
documents.license_note: Openly downloadable model closing opinion of company counsel; free per the site's terms. By definition a document only counsel can give — included so founders know what their firm is signing.

documents.name: NVCA Financing Documents Generator
documents.license_note: Free generator that assembles the NVCA model documents from a term-sheet questionnaire, under Cooley GO's terms of use. Speeds up the first draft; the negotiation is still counsel's job.

documents.name: Convertible Note Financing Term Sheet
documents.license_note: Free generator under Cooley GO's terms of use. Notes carry maturity and interest mechanics SAFEs do not — understand the differences before choosing the instrument.

documents.name: Convertible Promissory Note and Term Sheet (Singapore)
documents.license_note: Free generator for a Singapore-law convertible note and term sheet under Cooley GO's terms of use; Singapore counsel for local securities formalities.

documents.name: SeedFAST — SEIS/EIS-compatible Advance Subscription Agreement (the UK SAFE analogue)
documents.license_note: The UK's de facto standard ASA. Honesty note: unlike the YC SAFE this is not an open download — SeedLegals generates it on their paid platform; the page documents the instrument. Included because founders asking for a 'UK SAFE' need the SEIS/EIS-compatible ASA, not a US SAFE.

documents.name: SeedNOTE — UK convertible loan note
documents.license_note: SeedLegals' convertible loan note for UK companies (not SEIS/EIS-friendly, unlike SeedFAST). Platform-generated, not an open download; seedlegals.com/seednote/ 404s, so this resource page is the live home.

documents.name: BSA-AIR — Accord d'Investissement Rapide (the French SAFE analogue)
documents.publisher: Originally SB Avocats + TheFamily; live overview and sample at Seedsummit
documents.license_note: The BSA-AIR was released open-source in France, but its original home (meetair.co) is now a squatted domain — this Seedsummit page with a sample BSA Air is the live reference. Warrant issuance has French corporate formalities; French counsel required.

documents.name: iSAFE — India Simple Agreement for Future Equity
documents.license_note: 100X.VC's open India adaptation of the SAFE, implemented as compulsorily convertible preference shares to fit Indian company law; the page hosts the template and explainer. Indian counsel for CCPS issuance formalities.

documents.name: SAFT — Simple Agreement for Future Tokens (form and whitepaper)
documents.publisher: SAFT Project (Cooley LLP and Protocol Labs)
documents.license_note: Open form and whitepaper. The securities-law treatment of token sales is contested and enforcement-active; specialist counsel is mandatory, not optional.

documents.name: Sample Cap Table — Financing Pro Forma
documents.license_note: Free spreadsheet template for modeling a priced round. The same arithmetic is implemented (and cited) in lib/openstartup/capTable.ts.

documents.name: Sample Cap Table (Simple)
documents.license_note: Free basic cap-table spreadsheet for pre-financing record-keeping — a lightweight stock-ledger stand-in until a proper ledger or cap-table platform takes over.

documents.name: Accredited Investor Questionnaire
documents.license_note: Free template for confirming investors meet the Reg D accredited-investor definition before a private placement. Exemption strategy (506(b) vs 506(c), Form D) is counsel's call.

documents.name: Sample VC Due Diligence Request List
documents.license_note: Free template showing what a priced-round diligence request actually contains — useful as a data-room checklist long before a round.

documents.name: Orrick Tech Studio forms library (incorporation, financing, equity, consents)
documents.license_note: Free startup forms library (browse at /en/tech-studio/forms, filterable by region/stage/topic); some downloads require registration, and all are subject to Orrick's site terms. Board actions have statutory formalities (see rules/US-DE) — counsel confirms validity.

documents.name: Incorporation Toolkit (Delaware) — charter, bylaws, consents, founder stock
documents.license_note: Free toolkit covering the core incorporation set (certificate, bylaws, board and stockholder consents, founder restricted stock); downloads may require registration, subject to Orrick's site terms. A second source to cross-check the Cooley GO package.

documents.name: Capitalization Table template (US)
documents.license_note: Free cap-table/stock-ledger template in Orrick's Tech Studio; downloads may require registration, subject to Orrick's site terms. The ledger of record should reconcile with board consents and stock certificates.

documents.name: Form of Employee Offer Letter
documents.license_note: Free generator for a US at-will offer letter. Employment law is state-specific (California especially) — counsel review before first use in a new state.

documents.name: Form of Employee Offer Letter (Singapore)
documents.license_note: Free generator adapting the offer letter to Singapore employment law under Cooley GO's terms of use; Employment Act coverage rules differ from US at-will norms.

documents.name: Offer Letter and Employment Agreement Package (UK)
documents.license_note: Free generator for a UK offer letter plus employment contract under Cooley GO's terms of use. UK statutory particulars (s.1 ERA) are mandatory content — the package exists because a US-style letter alone is not compliant.

documents.name: Form of Employee Confidential Information and Inventions Assignment Agreement (CIIAA/PIIA)
documents.license_note: Free generator for the standard invention-assignment agreement every employee signs. Several states statutorily limit assignment scope (e.g. California Labor Code 2870-style carve-outs) — use the state-correct notice.

documents.name: Form of Employee Confidential Information and Inventions Assignment Agreement (Singapore)
documents.license_note: Free generator for the Singapore-law CIIAA under Cooley GO's terms of use; restraint-of-trade clauses are policed differently under Singapore common law than in US states.

documents.name: Balanced Employee IP Agreement (BEIPA)
documents.license_note: GitHub's employee IP agreement, released under CC0 — a deliberately employee-friendly alternative to the maximalist CIIAA that only claims IP tied to company business. Compare with cooley-ciiaa and take counsel on which scope fits.

documents.name: Form of Advisor Agreement
documents.license_note: Free generator for an advisor agreement with optional equity compensation; grants still require board approval and a 409A-defensible strike (see rules/US-FED and rules/US-DE).

documents.name: Form of Advisor Agreement (Singapore)
documents.license_note: Free generator for a Singapore-law advisor agreement under Cooley GO's terms of use; equity for advisors in a Singapore company has its own corporate approvals.

documents.name: FAST — Founder / Advisor Standard Template
documents.license_note: Free standard advisor agreement with a published equity matrix by advisor level and company stage. The matrix is a convention, not law — board approval and a 409A-defensible strike still apply to any grant.

documents.name: Form of Consulting Agreement
documents.license_note: Free generator for an independent-contractor consulting agreement with IP assignment. Worker classification is a legal determination — misclassification penalties are real; counsel when in doubt.

documents.name: Form of Consulting Agreement (Singapore)
documents.license_note: Free generator for a Singapore-law consulting agreement under Cooley GO's terms of use; contractor-vs-employee classification exists in Singapore too (CPF obligations turn on it).

documents.name: Form of Consultancy Agreement (UK)
documents.license_note: Free generator for a UK consultancy agreement under Cooley GO's terms of use. IR35/off-payroll rules make UK contractor status a tax determination — specialist advice when in doubt.

documents.name: Cloud Service Agreement (standard)
documents.license_note: Open standard agreement maintained by an attorney committee, published under a Creative Commons license (confirm the current license text on the page). Standard terms + a cover page of business variables.

documents.name: Terms of Service (standard)
documents.license_note: Open standard click-through ToS under Common Paper's Creative Commons licensing (confirm on page) — the self-serve counterpart of the negotiated CSA. Consumer-protection overlays vary by market.

documents.name: Service Level Agreement (standard)
documents.license_note: Open standard SLA under Common Paper's Creative Commons licensing (confirm on page); attaches to the CSA with uptime and credit variables on the cover page.

documents.name: Professional Services Agreement (standard)
documents.license_note: Open standard PSA under Common Paper's Creative Commons licensing (confirm on page) for implementation/services work alongside a product subscription; pair with statements of work.

documents.name: Design Partner Agreement (standard)
documents.license_note: Open standard agreement under Common Paper's Creative Commons licensing (confirm on page) for pre-launch design partners — feedback, early access, and IP boundaries before a paid contract exists.

documents.name: Pilot Agreement (standard)
documents.license_note: Open standard pilot/POC agreement under Common Paper's Creative Commons licensing (confirm on page); time-boxes an evaluation with explicit conversion terms to a full CSA.

documents.name: Partnership Agreement (standard)
documents.license_note: Open standard partnership (referral/reseller-style commercial partnership) agreement under Common Paper's Creative Commons licensing (confirm on page) — not a legal 'partnership' entity formation document.

documents.name: Software License Agreement (standard)
documents.license_note: Open standard license agreement under Common Paper's Creative Commons licensing (confirm on page) for on-prem/self-hosted software, where the CSA's hosted-service framing doesn't fit.

documents.name: Mutual NDA (standard)
documents.license_note: Open standard mutual NDA under a Creative Commons license (confirm on page); designed to be signed as-is so neither side pays lawyers to renegotiate boilerplate.

documents.name: oneNDA — the open standard NDA
documents.license_note: Free standard mutual NDA adopted by thousands of organizations; the standard's whole value is using it unmodified. Check the site's license terms for redistribution specifics; the sibling oneDPA is cataloged separately (onedpa).

documents.name: Bonterms Cloud Terms (standard)
documents.license_note: Committee-drafted standard cloud subscription terms, free under CC BY 4.0; download from this page (per-form pages returned 404 when checked). An Online Cloud Terms click-through variant lives on the same page.

documents.name: Bonterms Mutual NDA (standard)
documents.license_note: Committee-drafted standard mutual NDA, free under CC BY 4.0; download from this page (per-form pages 404). A third fixed-standard option alongside oneNDA and Common Paper's.

documents.name: Bonterms One-Way NDA (standard)
documents.license_note: Committee-drafted standard one-way NDA, free under CC BY 4.0; download from this page (per-form pages 404). For the disclosures where mutuality is wrong, e.g. diligence on your side only.

documents.name: Bonterms Service Level Agreement (standard)
documents.license_note: Committee-drafted standard SLA attachment to the Cloud Terms, free under CC BY 4.0; download from this page (per-form pages 404).

documents.name: Bonterms Professional Services Agreement (standard)
documents.license_note: Committee-drafted standard professional services agreement, free under CC BY 4.0; download from this page (per-form pages 404). Marketplace End User and Reseller forms and a Climate Addendum live on the same page.

documents.name: Bonterms Software License Terms (standard)
documents.license_note: Committee-drafted standard license terms for installed/self-hosted software, free under CC BY 4.0; download from this page (per-form pages 404).

documents.name: Sales Agreement Template (SaaS sales)
documents.license_note: YC's free standard SaaS sales agreement, published so early startups can close first customers without drafting from scratch. Enterprise counterparties will still redline — know your fallbacks.

documents.name: Form of Non-Disclosure Agreement (Mutual)
documents.license_note: Free generator for a conventional mutual NDA — the negotiable alternative when a counterparty won't sign a fixed standard like oneNDA, Common Paper's, or Bonterms'.

documents.name: Form of Non-Disclosure Agreement (One-Way)
documents.license_note: Free generator for a unilateral NDA under Cooley GO's terms of use, for one-directional disclosures where a mutual form overexposes you.

documents.name: Form of Non-Disclosure Agreement UK (Mutual)
documents.license_note: Free generator for an English-law mutual NDA under Cooley GO's terms of use; a unilateral UK variant is cataloged at cooley-unilateral-nda-uk.

documents.name: Form of Non-Disclosure Agreement UK (Unilateral)
documents.license_note: Free generator for an English-law one-way NDA under Cooley GO's terms of use, for one-directional disclosures under UK law.

documents.name: Form of Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Singapore)
documents.license_note: Free generator for a Singapore-law mutual NDA under Cooley GO's terms of use, rounding out the Singapore form set (offer letter, CIIAA, advisor, consulting, note).

documents.name: Data Processing Agreement (standard)
documents.license_note: Open standard DPA under a Creative Commons license (confirm on page). Privacy regimes move quickly — verify the current version covers the transfer mechanisms you rely on (eu-scc-international-transfers, uk-idta-addendum).

documents.name: Business Associate Agreement (standard)
documents.license_note: Open standard HIPAA BAA under Common Paper's Creative Commons licensing (confirm on page). Whether you are a business associate at all is the threshold question — health-data counsel answers it.

documents.name: AI Addendum (standard)
documents.license_note: Open standard addendum under Common Paper's Creative Commons licensing (confirm on page) covering AI-specific terms — training-data rights, model outputs, usage restrictions — on top of a CSA or ToS.

documents.name: Bonterms Data Protection Addendum (standard)
documents.license_note: Committee-drafted standard DPA, free under CC BY 4.0; download from this page (per-form pages 404). Confirm it carries the transfer mechanisms your data flows need.

documents.name: Bonterms Business Associate Agreement (standard)
documents.license_note: Committee-drafted standard HIPAA BAA, free under CC BY 4.0; download from this page (per-form pages 404). HHS's own sample BAA provisions page blocks scripted fetches, so the open standards are the verifiable homes here.

documents.name: Bonterms AI Addendum (standard)
documents.license_note: Committee-drafted standard AI addendum, free under CC BY 4.0; download from this page (per-form pages 404). Covers AI feature terms layered onto the Cloud Terms.

documents.name: oneDPA — the open standard Data Processing Agreement
documents.license_note: Free crowd-drafted standard DPA from the oneNDA initiative, designed to be used unmodified across jurisdictions. As with any DPA, the transfer-mechanism annexes must match your actual data flows.

documents.name: EU Standard Contractual Clauses for international data transfers (Decision 2021/914)
documents.license_note: Official EC page for the modernised SCCs adopted 4 June 2021 — the GDPR Art. 46 transfer mechanism most DPAs incorporate. EU documents are freely reusable with attribution; use the modular clauses exactly as adopted.

documents.name: EU standard contractual clauses hub (incl. Art. 28 controller–processor clauses)
documents.license_note: Official EC hub for both SCC sets (international transfers and the intra-EU/EEA Art. 28 controller–processor clauses). The Art. 28 set had no separately resolvable sub-page when checked — this hub is the stable link.

documents.name: UK International Data Transfer Agreement (IDTA) and UK Addendum to the EU SCCs
documents.license_note: Official ICO page hosting the IDTA and the UK Addendum (in force 21 March 2022) — the UK GDPR transfer mechanisms. Crown material under the Open Government Licence; the older ICO guidance path for these documents now 404s, this is the current home.

documents.name: Apache Individual Contributor License Agreement (ICLA)
documents.license_note: The ASF's individual CLA, the de facto template for startup CLA programs. Freely published; adapting it for your company means changing the named beneficiary — counsel for anything beyond that.

documents.name: Apache Corporate Contributor License Agreement (CCLA)
documents.license_note: The ASF's corporate CLA covering contributions made by a company's employees; pairs with the ICLA when contributors code on work time.

documents.name: Harmony contributor agreement templates (CLA/CAA generator)
documents.license_note: Open templates (CC-licensed) for individual and entity contributor license/assignment agreements with a selector for license-grant options — the configurable alternative to adopting Apache's CLAs verbatim.

documents.name: Developer Certificate of Origin (DCO) 1.1
documents.license_note: The lightweight sign-off alternative to a CLA, used by the Linux kernel and many startups' open-source projects; the text itself may be copied but not modified. Choosing DCO vs CLA is an IP-strategy decision.

documents.name: Choose a License (open-source license chooser)
documents.license_note: GitHub's free license chooser with full license texts and plain-language permission/condition summaries (site content CC BY 3.0). Which license fits your commercial strategy is a business decision worth counsel.

documents.name: OSI Approved Licenses list
documents.license_note: The canonical list of OSD-conformant licenses with their full texts. 'Open source' claims against non-OSI-approved licenses (source-available, BUSL-style) invite community pushback — label honestly.

documents.name: SPDX License List
documents.license_note: The machine-readable registry of license identifiers used in package metadata and SBOMs; free to use. The identifier in your package.json should match the LICENSE file — auditors check.

documents.name: Contributor Covenant (open-source code of conduct)
documents.publisher: Organization for Ethical Source / Coraline Ada Ehmke
documents.license_note: The most widely adopted open-source code of conduct, freely reusable (CC BY 4.0); this repo's own CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md is the usual adoption pattern. Enforcement contact details are the part you must actually fill in.

documents.name: Creative Commons license suite and chooser
documents.license_note: Official overview of the six CC licenses plus CC0 for content (docs, data, media) rather than code — this repo's own data ships under CC BY 4.0 (see DATA-LICENSE). CC licenses are not recommended for software.
